narrative: A 21-year-old from Aleppo had worked with various humanitarian relief organizations in the city before joining the Syrian opposition as an assistant surgeon and as director of an office of civil activity. His journey to Germany took him 17 days and cost $3,500; he arrived in Berlin in July 2015. The most frightening moment of the trip was the crossing of the Aegean to the island of Lesbos. In Hungary his friends were arrested, and he was forced to complete the rest of the journey alone. His parents, his two brothers and his two sisters were living in Turkey.
